title: Manufacturer census reconciliation 911 → 906
honesty: 906 is preferred to 911 when the delta is canonicalisation (rename / duplicate / non-OEM), not loss of real transformer manufacturers. Public counters (site-stats) showed 911→906; country-grouped manufacturers.json maker rows moved 908→902 in the pre-sprint backup vs current (same reconciliation events).
method: Diff data/backup-pre-sprint/manufacturers.json maker rows against current data/manufacturers.json; classify via data/duplicate-review.json alias_map and OEM-scope review.
